title: Get Recording Features
description: Returns the current settings for recording features, such as whether recording is turned on/off.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Determines which platform to show settings from - `web` or `mobile`. Defaults to `web`.

enabled.description: whether recording is enabled at all

recordingShutoff.description: Indicates if all recording has been shut off by FS personnel, usually via admin pages

lastUpdated.description: When this entity was last updated.

lastUpdatedBy.description: Who made the last update to this entity.

created.description: When this entity was first created.
